newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - April 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - April 3.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Thursday, as reported by Kyodo news agency:
-- Japan's Supreme Court rules the use of public funds to Yasukuni Shrine unconstitutional.
-- Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto and Shinshinto (New Frontier Party) leader Ichiro Ozawa will meet again on issue of expropriation of land for U.S. military in Okinawa.
-- Japan may stop setting an interim target for its Official Development Assistance (ODA) programmes.
-- Guarantors and Peruvian government will begin work on accord on hostage crisis in Lima.
